overview_description.description: Infobrim is an AI-Native BI Lakehouse that unifies distributed data to deliver real-time, AI-driven decisions. We close the gap between complex, slow-to-deploy BI and lightweight tools that can’t scale or govern—delivering enterprise power with startup simplicity. Through data federation, teams analyze data where it lives—no heavy ETL or duplication—using natural-language questions, auto-insights, and predictive signals. Governance is built in (catalog, lineage, roles, masking, audit, encryption). Deploy cloud, on-prem, or hybrid and scale company-wide with faster time-to-value and lower TCO.
